stories.title: Elderly woman 'violently assaulted' during home invasion in Lynnwood
stories.summary: An 82-year-old woman was stabbed and assaulted by a suspect who broke into her home on Tuesday night, Lynnwood police say.

stories.title: Good To Go! website offline after security threat; WSDOT says toll customer data appears safe
stories.summary: The vendor that runs Good To Go's billing system spotted the threat Sunday night and took the website and customer service offline.

stories.title: Invasive golden mussels discovered on Washington state-bound boat for first time
stories.summary: Washington wildlife officials found invasive golden mussels on a boat from California.

stories.title: Man shot in south Seattle turns up wounded in Tukwila; shooter still sought
stories.summary: The man is in stable condition at Harborview, where Seattle police are waiting to talk with him about what happened.

stories.title: Tacoma police investigate suspicious death after man found with signs of trauma
stories.summary: Police said they found a deceased man with signs of trauma when responding to reports of a person on the ground.

stories.title: Environmental group sues King County over nitrogen, phosphorus from West Point treatment plant
stories.summary: Nitrogen and phosphorus act like fertilizer in water, feeding algae that use up oxygen. A new lawsuit says West Point releases them unchecked.

stories.title: No injuries reported after fire engulfs two-story North Bend home
stories.summary: Flames fully engulfed a single-family home outside the Riverpoint area. Everyone was able to get out, and the cause remains under investigation.

stories.title: Seattle Public Schools issues guidance to families for transgender student athlete ban
stories.summary: Initiative 638, which bans transgender girls from competing in girls’ school sports, will take effect Dec. 3, barring an injunction.

stories.title: Lake Sammamish kokanee salmon return tops 3,000 after years of struggle
stories.summary: For the first time in 20 years, over 1,000 of the native salmon have returned to spawn for three years in a row.

stories.title: 5 years after Oakley Carlson vanished, new prosecutor offers hope for justice
stories.summary: Dec. 6 marks five years since Oakley Carlson was reported missing. A $100,000 reward is offered for tips on her whereabouts.

stories.title: Airport workers demand Alaska Airlines call for ICE's removal from airports
stories.summary: Alaska Airlines says it is engaging with government authorities and industry partners following Saturday's ICE arrests and Tuesday's demonstration.

stories.title: Cannon Beach visitor and dog swept up in sneaker wave after warning about king tides
stories.summary: The Cannon Beach Police Department shared dramatic video of the incident, where a man and his dog were washed down the shore. Both are alright, the agency said.
